title: 太空那么冷，显卡凭啥热死？
title_en: Space Is Freezing. Why Do GPUs Overheat?

segments.en: Elon Musk says:

segments.zh: 到2029年，天上的AI算力要碾压地面。
segments.en: by 2029, AI computing in orbit will crush computing on the ground.

segments.zh: 据报道，他预计2028年底左右，
segments.en: Reportedly, he expects that around the end of 2028,

segments.zh: 太空每月新增的算力就会超过地面。
segments.en: new computing added in space each month will pass the ground.

segments.zh: 听起来很美：太空零下两百七十度，
segments.en: Sounds great: space is minus two hundred seventy degrees,
a giant free fridge!
Today's brain teaser:

segments.zh: 太空那么冷，显卡凭啥会热死？
segments.en: space is so cold, so how can a GPU overheat?
Meet our hero, Chip,
an AI graphics card.
When it works,

segments.zh: 一块就要吃掉大约七百瓦。
segments.en: one card eats about seven hundred watts.
Almost all that electricity
turns into heat.
On the ground, how does heat leave?
Through the air.

segments.zh: 风扇一吹，热空气被赶走，
segments.en: A fan blows the hot air away,
and cool air rushes in.
Add water cooling,
and the heat is carried all the way outside.
Twist one: in space,
there is no air.

segments.zh: 没有空气，风扇转得再快，
segments.en: With no air, however fast the fan spins,
it moves nothing.
Space is not a fridge.
It is a thermos.
Why does a thermos keep things hot?
The gap in its wall is a vacuum.
Heat cannot leave by touching,
or by blowing.
The cold is real,

segments.zh: 可那份冷根本碰不到你。
segments.en: but it never touches you.
So what way out is left for heat?
Glowing.

segments.zh: 所有东西都在发看不见的红外光，
segments.en: Everything gives off invisible infrared light,
including you and me.

segments.zh: 其实你在黑夜里也在发光，
segments.en: You glow in the dark too.

segments.zh: 热成像相机拍到的就是它。
segments.en: A thermal camera sees exactly that.
This is thermal radiation,
the only exit in space.
Twist two: this exit
is shockingly narrow.

segments.zh: 国际空间站有好几大片散热板，
segments.en: The space station has several big radiator panels.

segments.zh: 据NASA资料，最多也就散掉约七十千瓦。
segments.en: According to NASA, they shed at most about seventy kilowatts.
How much is seventy kilowatts?

segments.zh: 估算一下：大约一百块显卡。
segments.en: A rough estimate: about one hundred GPUs.
And a big AI data center
can hold hundreds of thousands.
What to do?
Make the radiators hotter.
Glowing follows a rule:

segments.zh: 绝对温度翻一倍，散热变十六倍。
segments.en: double the absolute temperature, and the heat shed goes up sixteen times.
It is the fourth power law:
temperature multiplied by itself four times.
But GPUs hate heat.
They cannot run that hot.
Chip says:
all I want is a fan.

segments.zh: 所以散热板只能做得巨大，
segments.en: So the radiators must be huge,
like giant pairs of wings.

segments.zh: 空间站上那些白色的大板子就是散热板，
segments.en: On the space station, the big white panels are radiators,
not solar panels.
Twist three, the strangest:
the Sun makes it worse.
In space no clouds block the Sun.

segments.zh: 向阳的一面能晒到一百多度。
segments.en: The sunny side can bake above one hundred degrees.

segments.zh: 所以散热板得侧着身子，
segments.en: So the radiators turn edge on,
dodging the Sun.
Then why does Musk want it?
Exactly for the Sun.

segments.zh: 合适的轨道上几乎一直有太阳，
segments.en: In the right orbit, sunlight is almost nonstop:
no night, no cloudy days.
Nearly free power,
and no fight over land or water.
Some big data centers on the ground

segments.zh: 有的要用大量的水来降温。
segments.en: use lots of water for cooling.
It comes down to a trade:

segments.zh: 省下的电，能不能抵掉散热的麻烦。
segments.en: can the power saved pay for the cooling trouble?

segments.zh: 友情提示：2029的时间表是马斯克的预测，
segments.en: Fine print: the 2029 timeline is Musk's prediction.

segments.zh: 还没有人在太空建成大型AI机房。
segments.en: Nobody has built a large AI data center in space yet.
One hundred GPUs is an estimate,

segments.zh: 十六倍是物理规律，都不是哪家公司的方案。
segments.en: sixteen times is physics. Neither is any company's design.

segments.zh: 所以，太空那么冷，显卡凭啥会热死？
segments.en: So why can a GPU overheat in freezing space?

segments.zh: 因为冷碰不到它，热也甩不出去。
segments.en: Because the cold can't touch it, and the heat can't get out.

segments.zh: 太空是全宇宙最大的保温瓶。
segments.en: Space is the biggest thermos in the universe.

segments.zh: 显卡上去，可别被泡成一杯热茶。
segments.en: Send a GPU up there, and don't let it steep like hot tea.

elements.text: 白色大板子 = 散热板
物理规律，不是公司方案
